overview: Research draft record, unpublished: every statement below is an unverified lead, not a verified fact. A medical university in Lviv, western Ukraine, whose foreign applicants are handled by a Faculty of Foreign Students. Draft record built from search-snippet leads on 2026-10-11: the official admission documents found are for the 2023 cycle and the only official fee table found is for 2021/22, so both are out of date and nothing from them is recorded as a value. Every field below is awaiting verification against the official pages listed under research references and nothing here is presented as a current fact.

preparatoryRoutes.name: Preparatory course for foreign citizens

languageOfInstruction.note: The course centres on an intensive Ukrainian-language programme; the language in which chemistry, biology and physics are taught is not stated in any official snippet (a non-official blog says the course is taught only in Ukrainian).

englishTrack.note: No snippet states an English-language preparatory track.

durationText.note: Search-snippet lead (official domain, 2026-10-11) — NOT verified; read the official page before publishing. Snippet (English page ?p=818, undated): "Foreign citizens who are not strong enough in Ukrainian language can enter a one-year Preparatory course, which includes an intense language program, as well as some basic training in Chemistry, Biology and Physics".

subjects.note: Search-snippet lead (official domain, 2026-10-11) — NOT verified; read the official page before publishing. Snippet (English page ?p=818, undated): "an intense language program, as well as some basic training in Chemistry, Biology and Physics"; the Ministry portal (undated) names final exams in Ukrainian Language, Biology, Chemistry and Physics.

certificateName.note: Certificate name not stated in any snippet.

progressionText.note: Search-snippet lead (Ministry of Education "Study in Ukraine" portal, a government source, 2026-10-11) — NOT verified; read the official page before publishing. Undated portal wording: "Graduate students of these courses can be enrolled for the first year studies to Danylo Halytsky Lviv National Medical University. After passing exams (Ukrainian Language, Biology, Chemistry and Physics)" — i.e. conditional on exams. Not recorded; quote the university's own wording verbatim after reading the official page.

appliesToEnglishDegreeTrack.note: Not stated. The official page says the course is for applicants "not strong enough in Ukrainian language"; whether English-track applicants use it is not stated.

startDate.note: The Ministry portal (undated) gives an autumn start date; not recorded. Record the start date only from the official page, with the year.

fee.note: The Ministry portal (undated) lists a preparatory-course fee; the figure is NOT recorded. Record a fee only from the official fee page, with the academic year.

eligibilityText.note: Lead (official page, undated): the course is for "Foreign citizens who are not strong enough in Ukrainian language". Record the official eligibility wording verbatim.
